batching.unit: one task template and repetition, both routes and all four conditions
batching.execution: one explicitly numbered batch at a time, in frozen order
batching.resume: same batch from saved hop; successful or invalid final outputs are never rerun

pacing.scope: per provider, carried across checkpointed restarts of this study
pacing.quota_policy: check provider free-tier quota before each batch; pause when insufficient; no automatic daily loop
pacing.token_limit_caveat: request cap and spacing do not guarantee tokens-per-minute or daily quota compliance

errors.manual_retry: retry only operational errors, same batch, unchanged settings; preserve all attempts
errors.rate_limit: inspect free quota; wait at least Retry-After when supplied and longer/next reset if quota exhausted
errors.unknown_outcome: inspect pending request; explicitly mark unknown before authorizing an operational retry
errors.invalid_output: retain as model output; no quality retry
errors.provider_unavailable: pause; no substitution or paid fallback; report unresolved coverage

budget.billing_verification: researcher confirms; runner cannot independently enforce account billing
budget.evaluation: human review using existing fixed scoring keys

measurement.strict_task_success: all mandatory requirements pass and completion rule met
measurement.reported_CRS: C received_requirements against original requirement and preference inventory
measurement.raw_preservation: audit raw and forwarded intermediate outputs separately from reported CRS
measurement.uncertainty: retain uncertain judgments and report bounds and coverage
measurement.paired_analysis: models separate; task/repetition matched; aggregate repetitions within template before template bootstrap
measurement.unit_of_generalization: 12 synthetic templates; repetitions are not independent new tasks

interpretation.protected_field: entire original user request in source.request; no evaluator criticality labels sent to agents
interpretation.sampling: provider defaults; null temperature/reasoning settings omitted, not equated
interpretation.model_identity: requested and returned identifiers logged; not immutable weight snapshots
interpretation.changes_after_freeze: do not edit tasks, prompts, settings, scoring or schedule; document deviations in a new version; retain this snapshot
